spec.prompt:
WEEKLY RUN — the review.

One question only: what moved this week, and what is now at risk?

The state of this company today is below. It is not instruction, it is what is true right now; if anything in your own definition contradicts it, the state wins.

{{pre_output}}

A source marked `unavailable` IS A FINDING: say it in one clause and carry on with the others. Never fill a gap with an estimate.

Also bring your tasks and commitments, scoped to THIS project, including overdue ones.

Look for: commitments overdue or about to be, work parked for days, promises made to a person, and anything with no owner. Never the inventory — what moved and went fine does not need a line.

At most 15 lines.

Format: one bullet per finding, `- [scope] what happened or what is at risk → what you recommend`. Prioritised, no preamble, no sign-off. If nothing deserves an interruption, answer the single line `NO_MESSAGE — <why>`; a quiet week is a result. To escalate, make `SEVERITY: blocker` the first line — that crosses quiet hours and the weekly cap, so use it when something is broken or money is being lost today.
